{npc:Boozer}, owner of the Hard Rock Racing Track in Venore, needs a new attraction and wants to find out the dwarves' secret beer recipe. Take his bottle to the Kazordoon brewery, fill it from the {item:Cask of Brown Ale} barrel and bring the sample back. You receive a {item:Light Shovel}, 10 Platinum Coins and 100 experience.
The recipe for the legendary dwarven beer is a closely guarded secret.

Mission *The Good Guard* of The Hidden City of Beregar Quest
During that mission you buy the {item:Dwarven Ale} from {npc:Boozer}, in Venore (3000 gp).
In **Venore**, go up to the floor above the depot and talk to {npc:Boozer}. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. He gives you a bottle and asks for a sample of Kazordoon's special brown ale.

Kazordoon is the dwarf city, inside the mountain The Big Old One, **west** of Venore ({coord:32614,31923,7}). Walk to the mountain entrance and enter the city (see the maps). Bring a {item:Rope} and a {item:Shovel}: on the way there are rope spots and hidden holes, and you may meet {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}, {creature:Wolf|Wolves} and {creature:Dwarf|Dwarfs}.
A = rope spot, B = hidden hole

You can also arrive by {wiki:Steamship} (from {npc:Gurbasch}, beneath Cormaya, or from {npc:Thorgrin}, in Farmine: {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}), but you disembark at the underground harbour, next to {npc:Brodrosch}; the route in the next image starts at the city's main entrance.

Travel to **Kazordoon**. After you pass the lava section at the city entrance, when you are in the area with {creature:Rat|Rats}, go **left** instead of heading north and follow the path that climbs through the mountains.
The route to the Kazordoon brewery
Fill the bottle at the barrel
On the top floor, in the **southeast** corner, there is a {item:Cask of Brown Ale}. Use the empty bottle on the barrel to fill it.
The Cask of Brown Ale in the southeast corner of the top floor

With the full bottle, come down from the brewery the same way through the mountains to the {creature:Rat|Rats} area, pass the lava section again and leave through Kazordoon's main entrance. Then walk back **east** to {wiki:Venore}, the way you came (use the {item:Rope} at the rope spots). If you prefer, {npc:Brodrosch}, at Kazordoon's underground harbour, takes you by {wiki:Steamship} to Cormaya ({key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes}), near Edron.
Go back to **Venore** and say {key:hi} and {key:mission} to {npc:Boozer}.
